risks.quote: AI tools have been developed in ways that may embed bias in decision-making.
The University is aware of the environmental and sustainability impacts of AI use.

responsibilities.quote: AI will not be used to make decisions about marks or academic outcomes unless its use is explicitly authorised, clearly communicated, pedagogically justified, and always with human oversight.
Individuals remain accountable for the accuracy, quality, and integrity of their work, regardless of whether AI tools are used to support it.
Use of AI must be honest, responsible, and appropriately transparent.

responsibilities.anchor: Practical tips for using AI the right way

responsibilities.quote: In some areas, the use of AI is governed by specific University policies, regulations, or external requirements. These must always be followed.
Follow guidance provided by your module convenor
responsibilities.anchor: Practical tips for using AI the right way

responsibilities.quote: The University is committed to supporting staff and students to develop the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to engage with AI critically, responsibly, and effectively.
Early engagement with relevant policies, guidance and support is essential in mitigating any risks associated with the use of AI.
These principles, and the guidance that supports them, will be reviewed regularly to ensure they remain appropriate and effective.
